data.name: Fathoms
data.detailed_description:
Your New Life in Fathoms 

Winning the lottery lets you and your wife escape the global crises on the surface and move to Fathoms – a new city deep on the ocean floor that promises a better life. 
 
But shortly after the two of you move into a small apartment, strange things start happening that slowly but surely make you doubt your own mind. Is it just the depth causing these unbearable headaches? Or are the eerie hallucinations merely a side effect of the Tiefenmedikament? At least your wife seems to be doing better with every passing day, even though fine black veins now show beneath her faded skin... and the two of you are slowly starting to like the sickeningly sweet stench in the apartment... 
 

About This Game 

In Fathoms, narrative psychological horror meets disturbing anomalies in an underwater-city apartment. Experience, through the first-person eyes of a young man, how the new home he shares with his wife slowly turns into a nightmare. Can you spot the anomalies 24 days in a row and inject the Tiefenmedikament in time? 

 

Stay Alert! 

Something is wrong in your cozy new apartment – you see monsters crawling out of dark corners, from somewhere you hear someone wheezing, and your wife stands at the window with strangely twisted limbs, laughing – quickly, you grab the syringe with the Tiefenmedikament and the haunting is over – blackout. But every single day you have to check anew whether an anomaly is occurring in your apartment or not – and here your powers of observation are your only weapon.  

Decide quickly:  

An anomaly appears? -> grab the syringe 

No anomaly? -> go to the front door and leave the apartment 

 

Features 

  • 100+ unique anomalies across three escalating severity levels 

  • A modern apartment that decays further with every passing day 

  • A deeply disturbing relationship story woven through three acts 

  • Atmospheric horror – no cheap jump scares (except for one or two, or three, promise) 

  • Underwater setting, inspired by...(you can probably guess ;-))

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (2.7 GHz 4 Core) / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X (3.5 GHz 4 Core) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (req. 6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (req. 6GB VRAM) / Intel ARC A380
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7-8700 (3.7 GHz 6 Core) / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X (3.7 GHz 8 Core) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 Super (req. 6GB VRAM) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (req. 6GB VRAM) / Intel ARC A770
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Fathoms contains intense psychological horror, including disturbing imagery, body horror, and the progressive physical transformation of characters. The game features unsettling changes to a loved one's appearance (eyes, skin, voice), environmental degradation, flickering lights, and oppressive atmospheric tension. Players may encounter themes of isolation, paranoia, loss of identity, and emotional distress. There is no sexual content. Violence is implied and psychological rather than graphic.
